name: Appartementhaus Wildauer
beschreibung: Appartementhaus Wildauer in Ebbs, Tyrol, offers self-catering holiday apartments in a serene location at the foot of the Kaisergebirge mountains. Each apartment is fitted with a kitchen as well as a private balcony or terrace. The property is an excellent starting point for hiking and ski touring. The town of Kufstein, featuring shops and dining options, is only about five kilometres away. On-site parking is available on the grounds. Guests can look forward to a close-to-nature setting and the freedom of an independent holiday.
